用环境占满画面，主体只作为一个小点出现在其中: Fill the frame with the environment; the subject is one small point inside it
主体完整入画，环境占据画面的大半: Subject fully in frame, the environment takes most of the shot
取景到腰部以上，主体动作与周围环境同时可见: Frame from the waist up; action and surroundings both visible
取景到胸部以上，背景开始虚化: Frame from the chest up; the background starts to blur
只留主体的一处细节，其余全部虚化: Keep one detail of the subject only; blur everything else
贴近到极近，让纹理占满整个画面: Move in extremely close so texture fills the whole frame
先把时间、地点与整体气氛立住，人物只是环境里的一个点: Establish time, place and overall mood first; the person is just one point in the environment
把主体完整放进环境里，让人一眼看清「谁、在哪」: Put the subject fully into the environment so who and where read at a glance
动作与姿态最清楚，是叙事的主力镜头: Action and posture read most clearly — the workhorse shot of the story
情绪开始显影，观众能读到表情: Emotion starts to surface; the audience can read the expression
把注意力钉在一个细节上，放大质感: Pin attention onto one detail and amplify its texture
贴近到肉眼难辨的尺度，制造陌生感: Move to a scale the naked eye cannot resolve, creating a sense of the unfamiliar
告诉 AI「你以谁的身份来回答」，它会自动切换到对应的判断标准和表达习惯。同一个: Tells the AI whose shoes it is standing in. It then switches to that role's standards and habits of speech. The same question gets a completely different answer from an expert than from a beginner.
交代清楚「给谁看、在什么情况下用」，AI 才会自动调整用词深度和举例方式。这是最: Say who it is for and where it gets used, and the AI adjusts its vocabulary and its examples on its own. This is the most overlooked block, and the one that pays off most.
保留你的原话，而不是让 AI 转述。原话里有你的语气和真实意图，转述一次就丢一分: Your own words, not the AI's paraphrase. Your phrasing carries your tone and your real intent — every paraphrase loses a little of both.
把「你觉得理所当然」的细节写出来 —— 正是因为你觉得理所当然，AI 才会漏掉它: Write down the details you take for granted. Precisely because they feel obvious to you, they are the ones the AI drops.
规定输出的形态、长度和结构。绝大多数「结果不能用」的问题，根源都在这里：不是内容: Pin down the shape, length and structure of the output. Most unusable results trace back here — the content was fine, the form was wrong.
语气和详略决定读起来像不像人话。这一块写得越具体，最后成品的「AI 味」越淡。: Tone and level of detail decide whether it reads like a person wrote it. The more specific this block is, the less the result smells of AI.
明确划出边界：不要什么、必须做到什么。约束比要求更能提升稳定性，因为它堵住了 A: Draw the boundary: what you do not want, what must always hold. Constraints buy more reliability than requests do, because they close off the room the AI would otherwise improvise in.
给例子是最快的对齐方式。一个具体样例传达的信息，往往比十句抽象描述都多。: An example is the fastest way to align. One concrete sample usually carries more than ten abstract sentences.
绘图模型只会画你写出来的东西。主体写得越具体，它自由发挥（也就是跑偏）的空间就越: An image model only draws what you write. The more specific the subject, the less room it has to improvise — which is to say, to wander off.
景别和视角决定了观众站在哪里看。这是区分「随手一张图」和「有设计的画面」的关键。: Shot size and angle decide where the viewer stands. This is what separates a casual snapshot from a composed image.
光线是画面里最贵的东西。同一个构图换一种光，就是完全不同的故事和价格感。: Light is the most expensive thing in a frame. Change the light on the same composition and you get a different story — and a different price tag.
氛围回答的是「看完感觉到什么」。只描述内容不描述情绪，出来的图往往正确但没有感染: Mood answers what the viewer feels afterwards. Describe only the content and the image comes out correct but flat.
色彩是最先被感知、最后被注意到的元素。定好基调，整张图才不会花。: Color is perceived first and noticed last. Fix the palette and the whole image stops looking messy.
画质与镜头描述决定了成图的「精致度」，也是让图片摆脱廉价感最直接的手段。: Quality and lens wording decide how refined the result looks — the most direct way to stop an image feeling cheap.
负面提示词是性价比最高的一步：写一句「不要什么」，比反复调整「要什么」快得多。: The negative prompt is the best value step: saying what you do not want is far faster than re-tuning what you do.
视频和图片的唯一区别就是「有变化」。把变化描述清楚，模型才知道该让什么动起来。: The only difference between video and a still is change. Describe the change and the model knows what to move.
景别是视频的语法。单一景别会显得单调，多个景别则意味着画面需要剪辑衔接。: Shot size is the grammar of video. One size reads as monotonous; several mean the shots have to be cut together.
推近的镜头如果不说清看什么，模型会自己挑一个 —— 而且常常挑到不重要的地方。所: If a close shot does not say what to look at, the model picks something itself — usually the wrong thing. So this only applies to close-ups and near shots; a wide shot has no focus point.
运镜是视频的「语气」：固定机位是克制，环绕是强调，手持是纪实。: Camera movement is the tone of voice of video: a locked-off shot is restraint, an orbit is emphasis, handheld is documentary.
剪辑结构是视频的「骨架」：一个镜头还是多个镜头，直接决定了你需要交代几个景别。一: Cut structure is the skeleton: one shot or many decides how many shot sizes you need to cover. A single take has no cut points, so blocking and camera movement have to carry the information; a storyboard cut can join different shot sizes and pack more in.
情绪走向是分镜的骨架。四个镜头同一个情绪，观众只会觉得平；定一条走向，每个镜头才: The emotional arc is the skeleton of a storyboard. Four shots at one emotion read as flat; set an arc and each shot knows which part of the whole it carries.
「画面细节」是把描述变具体的唯一办法。「一个人在雨中走」谁都能写，但「伞面的雨珠: Visual details are the only way to make a description concrete. Anyone can write a person walking in the rain; raindrops on the umbrella and reflections in the puddle are what the model can actually draw.
时长直接决定模型输出什么。超过 15 秒的片子必须拆成分镜，否则会前后不连贯。: Duration decides what the model can output. Anything past 15 seconds has to be broken into shots, or it will drift.
声音占观看体验的一半。如果工具不支持音频，明确说「不需要」可以避免画面被强行配乐: Sound is half the experience. If your tool has no audio, saying you do not need it keeps the visuals from being scored anyway.
是否说清了要做什么: Whether it says what to do
是否指定了 AI 的身份: Whether an AI role is specified
是否交代了来龙去脉和给谁看: Whether the background and the audience are stated
是否规定了形态、长度与结构: Whether format, length and structure are set
是否定了调性和详略程度: Whether tone and level of detail are set
是否划清了不做什么: Whether it rules out what not to do
是否提供了对齐样例: Whether a reference example is given
是否说清了画的是什么: Whether it says what is being drawn
景别、角度与画幅: Shot size, angle and aspect ratio
光的方向与质感: Direction and quality of the light
视觉风格是否明确: Whether the visual style is clear
画的是什么、发生了什么: What is drawn and what happens
